issues.description: Script sends data to discord.com via GM_xmlhttpRequest, which may include user actions or game data.
issues.recommendation: Limit data sent to Discord, ensure no sensitive user information is transmitted.

issues.description: Script sends requests to nominatim.openstreetmap.org, likely for geocoding. Potential for user location data leakage.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary location data is sent, avoid transmitting user identifiers.

issues.description: Script listens to WebSocket messages and processes opponent guesses, which may expose user/game data.
issues.recommendation: Do not transmit user/game data externally unless necessary and with user consent.

issues.description: Script accesses localStorage and sessionStorage, and modifies Storage.prototype.setItem.
issues.recommendation: Avoid unnecessary access to storage, do not store sensitive data.

issues.description: Script uses Notification API to send notifications.
issues.recommendation: Ensure notifications are not abused or used for phishing.

issues.description: Script uses @require to load msgpack.js from greasyfork update CDN, but does not fix version hash.
issues.recommendation: Pin third-party dependencies to a specific version hash to prevent supply chain attacks.

issues.description: Script applies Proxy to Element.prototype.setAttribute and Array.prototype.push, which may affect page behavior.
issues.recommendation: Avoid modifying global prototypes unless necessary; restrict scope.

issues.description: Script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which is high privilege.
issues.recommendation: Limit usage to only required domains; review necessity.

script_name: CheatGuessr Universal | GeoGuessr | OpenGuessr | WorldGuessr | FreeGuessr | GeoDuels | Geotastic
summary: This script poses significant security and privacy risks due to data transmission to third-party servers (discord.com, nominatim.openstreetmap.org), processing of user/game data, and modification of browser prototypes. Supply chain and permission risks are also present. Not recommended for use in sensitive environments.
